title: The Erdős--Chvátal Simplex Conjecture
summary: We prove the Erdős--Chvátal simplex conjecture across its entire parameter range. If $2\le d<k$ and $(d+1)k\le dv$, then every $d$-simplex-free family of $k$-subsets of $[v]$ has at most $\binom{v-1}{k-1}$ members, with equality only for a full star.
